channel.title: Maccy (VyvIT fork)
channel.description: Releases of the VyvIT fork of Maccy. Updated by scripts/release-fork.sh.

item.title: 2.8.0-vv5
item.description:
Fifth release of the VyvIT fork of Maccy 2.8.0.

  • Added shortcuts to open only snippets (⌘⌥§) or only history (⌘⇧§), next to Open in General settings.
  • Snippet folders show ⌘1 to ⌘9 when only snippets are open, and pressing the number opens the folder.
  • Previews now open with → and close with ← by default. Automatic previews after a delay can be chosen in Appearance settings.
  • Added settings for how many history items show before the list scrolls: 10, and 20 when only history is open.
  • Clicking the color swatch of a hex color opens the color picker. Copy adds the adjusted color as a new item.
  • Appearance settings are split into tabs, with hints under options that aren't obvious.
  • The preview button shows a list icon while the preview is open.
  • Fixed Maccy quitting when the popup shortcut was held and repeated until the highlight reached Quit.
  • Fixed the preview button sliding under the search field while the preview opened on the left.

item.title: 2.8.0-vv4
item.description:
Fourth release of the VyvIT fork of Maccy 2.8.0.

  • Added a Language picker to General settings, with a Restart button to apply it.
  • Added translations of snippets, the snippets editor and password hiding to all languages.
  • Fixed the history database keeping its largest size after deleting items, e.g. after copying screenshots. It now shrinks a few seconds after items are deleted, cleared or trimmed, and at launch.
  • Fixed the history size in Storage settings leaving out recent changes.
  • Removed the Marker highlight style, as Color highlights matches almost the same way. Color is the default now.

item.title: 2.8.0-vv3
item.description:
Second release of the VyvIT fork of Maccy 2.8.0. Fixes 2.8.0-vv1 quitting at launch.

  • Added snippets: reusable text in folders, listed above the footer. Hover a folder or press → to open it, then choose a snippet with Return, a click or keys 1–9 and 0.
  • Added a preview of snippets next to the snippet menu, with its own delay setting.
  • Added the snippets editor (Edit Snippets… in the footer) with drag and drop, search, renaming with a double click, enabling and disabling, and copying with ⌘C, ⌘V and ⌘D.
  • Added importing and exporting snippets in the Clipy format.
  • Added hiding passwords in the history: only the first and last characters are shown until you hover the eye button. Can be turned off in Appearance settings.
  • Added the Marker highlight style for search matches and made it the default.
  • Changed the default preview delay to 500 ms.
  • Fixed an empty preview when moving from the history to the footer with the keyboard.
